name: dragon-ball-budokai
description: 龙珠少年武道会：模块化 Three.js 格斗游戏

scripts.deploy:pages: npm run build && wrangler pages deploy dist --project-name dragon-ball-budokai --branch main
scripts.format: prettier --write src tests scripts *.js *.json index.html docs/*.md README.md
scripts.format:check: prettier --check src tests scripts *.js *.json index.html docs/*.md README.md
scripts.validate: npm run lint && npm run format:check && npm run architecture:check && npm run test:unit && npm run build && npm test && npm run test:offline
scripts.test:offline: npm run build:offline && OFFLINE_TEST=1 playwright test --grep 'offline export'
